definition.def: If you avert something unpleasant, you prevent it from happening.
examples: Talks with the teachers' union over the weekend have averted a strike. [VERB noun]
A fresh tragedy was narrowly averted yesterday.

definition.def: If you avert your eyes or gaze from someone or something, you look away from them.
examples: He avoids any eye contact, quickly averting his gaze when anyone approaches. [VERB noun]

examples.sentence: Creating the sub-brand allowed Coach to avert an across-the-board price cut.
